payload.name: Include plan memories for date-specific idea questions
payload.description: When a question asks what idea, plan, or initiative someone had on a specific date and initial retrieval returns no relevant memory, apply before answering no information.
content: When the question asks about an idea, plan, or initiative on a date and initial searches return no matching memory, rerun searches without restricting memory_kinds to event; include 'plan' (and 'state' or 'profile' when the idea is expressed as an intention or interest).
Use date-filtered structured and keyword searches with the person's name and the date, querying with terms such as plan, idea, initiative, volunteer program, or propose.
Stop once a memory with a world_start on or near the date answers the question; if none is found, answer no information without expanding to unrelated dates or topics.

solves: When a date-specific question asks about an idea, plan, or initiative someone had, retrieval may fail because searches are restricted to event memories even though the answer is stored as a plan memory. This skill ensures plan memories are included in date-filtered searches before concluding no information is available.
